purpose: Time-frozen preseason projection sources eligible for FSFFL historical calibration. This inventory stores provenance only; it does not assert predictive superiority.
eligibility_rule: A snapshot must be demonstrably published no later than the opening date of the NFL regular season for that season. Same-day snapshots are flagged for manual time-of-day review before authoritative use.

position_expansion.rule: Before using another position-season snapshot, verify that its displayed update date matches the eligible time-frozen season snapshot rather than assuming the QB date applies to all positions.

remaining_requirement: Add at least one independent source with comparable time-frozen preseason snapshots and normalize projections and realized FSFFL-scored outcomes before source/blend promotion.
